description: This is a test source file for the AnySoftKeyboard project, specifically testing the behavior of navigation bar colorization and padding adjustments in various scenarios using Robolectric and Mockito frameworks.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardColorizeNavBarTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying navigation bar colorization and padding behavior in the AnySoftKeyboard app.

classes.name: TestShadowResources
classes.description: Shadow class for Resources to mock navigation bar height and configuration.

classes.name: TestShadowResourcesZeroHeight
classes.description: Shadow class for Resources returning zero height for navigation bar.

classes.name: TestShadowResourcesSmallHeight
classes.description: Shadow class for Resources returning a small height for navigation bar.

classes.name: TestShadowResourcesFalseConfig
classes.description: Shadow class for Resources indicating navigation bar is not shown.

classes.name: TestShadowResourcesNoConfigResId
classes.description: Shadow class for Resources with no resource ID for navigation bar config.

classes.name: TestShadowResourcesNoResId
classes.description: Shadow class for Resources with no resource ID for navigation bar height.

classes.name: TestShadowPhoneWindow
classes.description: Shadow class for PhoneWindow to mock window behavior related to system UI flags.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes minimum height from resources before each test.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies the default behavior when navigation bar colorization is enabled.

methods.name: testExtraPadding
methods.description: Tests padding adjustments based on user preferences for extra bottom padding.

methods.name: testExtraPaddingWithNegativeValue
methods.description: Ensures negative padding values are handled correctly, defaulting to zero or minimum height.

methods.name: testNoExtraPaddingInLandscape
methods.description: Checks that extra padding is not applied in landscape mode.

methods.name: testHappyPathForSmallNavigationBar
methods.description: Tests behavior with a small navigation bar height.

methods.name: testHappyPathSdk30
methods.description: Verifies behavior on SDK 30 with specific window flags and navigation bar color.

methods.name: testDoesNotClearPaddingIfRestartingInput
methods.description: Ensures padding is not reset when input is restarted.

methods.name: testDoNotDrawIfSettingIsOff
methods.description: Checks that no padding or colorization occurs if the setting is disabled.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetPaddingIfOsSaysNoNavBar
methods.description: Verifies no padding is set if OS indicates no navigation bar.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetPaddingIfNoConfigResource
methods.description: Ensures no padding is set if configuration resource ID is missing.

methods.name: testSetsPaddingInLandscape
methods.description: Checks padding adjustment in landscape mode with specific resource configuration.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetPaddingIfNoNavigationBarRes
methods.description: Verifies no padding if navigation bar resource ID is missing.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetPaddingIfNavHeightIsZero
methods.description: Ensures no padding is set if navigation bar height is zero.
